run_cluster_pdb_train_mmcifs_cli: run the cluster_pdb_train_mmcifs script to cluster AlphaFold 3 PDB training dataset mmCIF files by chain and interface
parse_chain_sequences_from_mmcif: parse chain sequences and structural interfaces from an mmCIF file using BioPython NeighborSearch
cluster_sequences_using_mmseqs2: cluster protein, nucleic acid, or peptide sequences using MMseqs2 with configurable sequence identity and coverage thresholds
cluster_ligands_by_ccd_code: cluster ligands by their CCD codes so that only identical small molecules share a cluster
cluster_interfaces: cluster protein-nucleic acid-peptide-ligand interfaces by joining the cluster IDs of their constituent chains
